goal: Let node operators designate specific peers to always use high-bandwidth compact block relay
Dedicated low-latency links and multi-region nodes receive blocks immediately without waiting for selection
agreement: Broad support with no open objections
Concept approval for giving operators explicit control over high-bandwidth peers (Bicaru20, jeanpablojp)
Suggested implementing this as a whitelist permission rather than an addnode option (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it benefits advanced operators running private low-latency links or multi-datacenter nodes
Avoids waiting for dynamic peer selection or losing high-bandwidth mode whenever connections restart
